metadata.description:
Proof that you helped with the beta test of the new POAP Checkout. 

The elves are incredibly thankful to have you beta testing POAP Checkout during the holiday period! Even though they are on holiday, they are still dedicated to delivering the best product possible. They appreciate that you are taking the time to test and provide feedback on this new exciting product. Your help is invaluable and they are so thankful that you are helping make POAP Checkout the best it can be. 

Thank you for your dedication and support during this special time of year!
metadata.name: POAP Checkout - Holiday Beta Tester
